Visible pixels touch the canvas; this alone does not prove clipping.

visual_review.evaluator: Codex inspection of full native/dark/light galleries and the titanium/old-Thorium/new-Thorium comparison
observations: Four angled mineral pockets sit in a neutral deepslate host reconstructed from the local ore reference. The mineral site layout is newly authored.
The metal ramp is less saturated and lower in contrast. Passing the technical checks does not establish artistic acceptance.
limitations: No creator approval of this revision has been supplied.
Textures only; no gameplay or in-game acceptance claim.

criteria.criterion: Requested object identity is recognizable rather than merely a valid PNG
Silhouette and dominant shapes readable at native size
Shading direction and highlight placement consistent with chosen reference
Color harmony, contrast and reference-supported hue shifting
Deliberate pixel clusters, edge treatment and suitable texture density
Recognizable style compared beside approved project references
Animation motion, flicker and first-to-last loop perceived in playback

four angled mineral pockets with cut crystal-like shard faces
style: new Thorium construction rather than titanium recolor
sharp chamfers and restrained plate seams
